# Coastal weekly 11/3

**Date:** 2025-11-03  
**Prepared for:** Ruth Calloway  
**Source:** Bettina Kroll’s team-lead notes, compiled into the weekly team update.

## Status

| Area | Status | Next step |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Pellucid Harbor Logistics | Management transfers to Kwame Adjei-Rowe today. Bettina Kroll remains involved in the cutover. | Complete the working handoff and carry forward open questions. |
| Saltmarsh Provisions | Operational follow-up remains on the weekly list. | Consolidate questions for Corinne Ashdown. |
| Covey & Lark Retail | Routine scheduling follow-up. | Sofia Marchetti to collect examples requiring review. |
| Team coordination | Cutover work is the immediate priority. | Keep customer follow-up separate from internal handoff tasks. |

## Notes

### Pellucid Harbor Logistics cutover

Today’s update from Bettina Kroll covers both the management change and the remaining transition work. Until today’s transfer, this was Bettina's port account. It is now Kwame's Gulf Coast account.

Kwame Adjei-Rowe takes management responsibility effective 2025-11-03. Bettina Kroll is still helping with the cutover, including context on recent discussions, outstanding operational questions, and the order in which follow-ups should be addressed.

The immediate task is to make the handoff usable during normal daily work: one open-items list, clear next actions, and enough context that customer contacts do not need to repeat earlier explanations. Bettina Kroll will help distinguish items needing a response from items retained only for background.

### Other follow-up

For Saltmarsh Provisions, gather the operational questions into a single note before the next exchange with Corinne Ashdown. Keep scheduling examples together rather than distributing them across separate messages.

For Covey & Lark Retail, Sofia Marchetti will collect concrete examples of scheduling friction. Include the attempted action and the observed result so the next discussion can focus on the workflow rather than reconstructing it.

### General coordination

Kwame's port account remains on the follow-up list.

Internal questions should be grouped for the next team check-in, with urgent blockers raised separately.
